## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive (Sector Weakness). Confirmations: extreme single-sector positivity (Energy only sector positive) and narrow leadership concentrated in Technology (Top 5: 4/5 Technology), producing mixed internals that justify a neutral read.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +2.33% | 1M: +4.58%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +9.83%) ABOVE TREND. Technology has top movers but mixed internals: AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +12.29% | 1M: +1.97%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Healthcare weakest: NVS (1W: -15.90% | 1M: -9.95%) BELOW TREND, AMGN (1W: -15.03% | 1M: -8.80%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary and Materials also lag on 1W weakness (e.g., SBUX (1W: -6.69% | 1M: -8.46%) BELOW TREND; FCX sentiment weak).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND; INTC (1W: +12.29% | 1M: +1.97%) ABOVE TREND; QCOM (1W: +7.95% | 1M: +12.20%) ABOVE TREND; ETN (1W: +7.11% | 1M: -7.52%) RECOVERY; META (1W: +6.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: NVS (1W: -15.90% | 1M: -9.95%) BELOW TREND; AMGN (1W: -15.03% | 1M: -8.80%) BELOW TREND; ADBE (1W: -11.73% | 1M: -2.52%) BELOW TREND; SHOP (1W: -11.72% | 1M: -14.37%) BELOW TREND; SYK (1W: -10.53% | 1M: -20.64%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Healthcare and select high-multiple Tech names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W: AMD (1W: +13.15%), INTC (1W: +12.29%), QCOM (1W: +7.95%), ETN (1W: +7.11%), META (1W: +6.12%). Note MAJOR DIVERGENCE: multiple large names show 1W vs 1M polarity (ETN, TXN, AMAT, CSCO, MSFT, NOW), so treat moves as tactical with risk of trend reversal.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed and internally bifurcated: AAPL (1W: +1.24% | 1M: +9.93%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +6.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: -4.34% | 1M: -2.48%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -2.84% | 1M: +0.84%) CORRECTION; sector 1W: -0.21% (24 stocks) shows dispersion.

8. Financials Outlook?
Soft on the week: JPM (1W: -1.61% | 1M: -2.45%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -2.19% | 1M: +3.07%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -2.82% | 1M: +1.69%) CORRECTION — breadth for Financials is negative and lacks leadership to push a risk-on.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Weak overall: UNH (1W: -5.45% | 1M: -6.53%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -3.79% | 1M: -8.44%) BELOW TREND, JNJ (1W: -4.62% | 1M: +2.31%) CORRECTION — sector 1W: -5.60% (17 stocks) shows pronounced selling.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective Energy names and idiosyncratic Tech winners (e.g., XOM (1W: +2.33% | 1M: +4.58%) ABOVE TREND; AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND), reduce exposure to large-cap momentum names showing structural weakness (NVDA (1W: -4.34% | 1M: -2.48%) BELOW TREND; MSFT (1W: -2.84% | 1M: +0.84%) CORRECTION). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow Tech top performance but broad sector weakness.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND — monitor follow-through; INTC (1W: +12.29% | 1M: +1.97%) ABOVE TREND for sustainability. BEARISH: NVS (1W: -15.90% | 1M: -9.95%) BELOW TREND; ADBE (1W: -11.73% | 1M: -2.52%) BELOW TREND — headline risk and confirmed price weakness.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +1.37% | 1M: +8.60%) — only positive sector and ABOVE TREND names. BEARISH: Healthcare (1W: -5.60% | 1M: -2.76%) and Consumer Discretionary (1W: -3.31% | 1M: -7.00%) — watch earnings/news flow.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: -4.34% | 1M: -2.48%) BELOW TREND needs to reclaim its monthly trend for risk-on confirmation; AAPL (1W: +1.24% | 1M: +9.93%) ABOVE TREND should hold weekly support to validate continuation; XOM (1W: +2.33% | 1M: +4.58%) ABOVE TREND staying positive would keep Energy leadership intact.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
JNJ (+55): JNJ (1W: -4.62% | 1M: +2.31%) CORRECTION — bullish talks on orthopedics but short-term price is softer, a divergence to watch. BA (+55): BA (1W: -0.03% | 1M: -8.97%) BELOW TREND — contract headline positive but price remains under pressure, watch for confirmation. PLTR (+50): PLTR (1W: -8.38% | 1M: -2.23%) BELOW TREND — Thiel-related flow is bullish sentiment but price declines, divergence present.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
NVS (-55): NVS (1W: -15.90% | 1M: -9.95%) BELOW TREND — bearish headlines confirming price weakness. ADBE (-50): ADBE (1W: -11.73% | 1M: -2.52%) BELOW TREND — downgrade-driven weakness confirmed by price. GOOGL (-45): GOOGL (1W: -1.10% | 1M: -1.40%) BELOW TREND — negative narrative aligns with rolling weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with style mixed / no clear leadership. AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND and XOM (1W: +2.33% | 1M: +4.58%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: narrow Tech leadership and MAJOR DIVERGENCE between 1W and 1M signals plus negative sentiment-confirmed names in Healthcare (NVS, ADBE) — watch for trend breaks.
